description: Mixes an existing song's stems and masters the mix in one go (draft, final mix, master), for example to mix it again with another genre or mastering style; a song made with create_song is already set up for this. It waits for the uploads, the analysis and the person's "Labels are correct" in the studio, then starts by itself. The mastering style is the one the person names (streaming when they name none). The studio shows the progress and plays the result; a new mix replaces the earlier version made in the chat (downloaded versions and mixes made on the website stay).

master.description: false = mix only, without a master (default true).

preset.description: Mastering style. streaming = optimized for Spotify and Apple Music; optimal = balanced ("Standard"); loud = maximum punch and loudness.

songId.description: The song id from list_songs or create_song.

name: mix_and_master
title: Mix and master a song
